lines.t: Do we have many options for the weekend trip?
A few. Most of the hotels near the beach are expensive.
What about these two small hotels?
Both of them have rooms, but neither of them includes breakfast.
That’s okay. We don’t have much luggage, so a small room is fine.
Would you like some help with the booking?
Yes, please. Can you check if either hotel has a quiet room?
Sure. Almost all the rooms at the first hotel face the street.
Then let’s try the other one. We want less noise.
Good idea. A few of my friends stay there every summer.
